analysis:
Examined all three cli-reference excerpts and cluster-always-on metadata/bounded patch against the canonical definition index and supplied T-041 detail. Changed documentation at docs/provider/cli-reference.md:1804-1809 describes manual updates requesting coordinated supervisor restart after pair drain, with a timeout and failure on deferral; line 2148 now documents automatic pair updates. The cluster-always-on patch at head lines 30, 34-39 removes the previous automatic-update exclusion and introduces a coordinated-update section at 115-195, whose full text is not supplied. No executable control changes are visible here, so these descriptions do not independently establish a security regression.
Surrounding CLI text preserves artifact-hash verification (1801-1802), explicit force semantics (1799), authorization/diagnostic distinctions, privacy-redacted reporting, and cache controls; these are not changed by this file's complete range map. In particular, the existing cache descriptions do not establish a new T-041 exposure in this PR.
Integration should verify UpdateCommand.swift/ClusterServiceUpdateRequest and the supervisor's AutoUpdateController integration: ownership/authentication of local and peer update requests, signed-artifact validation on each Mac, drain/cancellation and child custody before restart, failure/timeout behavior, and refresh of connection-bound authorization after replacement (T-043, T-010, T-053, T-054; A-018 availability). The expanded cluster-always-on section also needs its actual source review. Missing implementation and truncated documentation are coverage limits, not observed missing controls; no billing, plaintext-encryption, or attestation bypass is supported by these units.
